description: This Java source file defines the SimpleCredentialHandler class, which implements the CredentialHandler interface for handling user credentials in Apache OFBiz, with a focus on password verification logic.

classes.name: SimpleCredentialHandler
classes.description: A credential handler for verifying passwords, implementing the CredentialHandler interface, with simple password matching logic.

methods.name: matches
methods.description: Checks if the input credentials match the stored credentials using the LoginServices.checkPassword method.

methods.name: mutate
methods.description: Returns null, indicating no mutation of input credentials; designed to handle clear-text passwords when encryption is disabled.
